phases.phase_role: The full Freddy chronology is long-lived context rather than the deciding rainfall phase.
The full-period rainfall total is the denominator for testing late-stage concentration.
The final three days contain more than one quarter of the full-period local rainfall.
The Malawi flood entry follows the wettest final-window day within the allowed 48-hour lag.

primary_gt.interpretation: The Malawi episode is a distinct late-phase concentration because 111.7 mm falls in the final three days, representing 29.8% of local event rainfall, and the flood entry follows the wettest final-window day by 34.0 hours.

criteria.name: Final ledger status
criteria.description: Reports pass with the requested four phases and numeric fields.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for the right status with one missing field or for a status that is clearly implied but not labeled.

criteria.name: Duration extraction
criteria.description: Reports 36.0 days within 0.2 days with units.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a nearby duration that is not tied to the Freddy chronology.

criteria.name: Event and final-window precipitation
criteria.description: Aggregates hourly precipitation to 375.2 mm for the full event period and 111.7 mm for 2023-03-12 through 2023-03-14.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a correct final-window sum with a missing or imprecise event total.

criteria.name: Share calculation
criteria.description: Computes 29.8% within 0.5 percentage points and compares it to the 25% threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for using the right numerator but a wrong denominator.

criteria.name: Lag calculation
criteria.description: Computes 34.0 hours within 1.0 hour from 2023-03-12T00:00:00 to 2023-03-13T10:00:00 and compares it to the 48-hour threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for the correct date order with an imprecise lag.

criteria.name: Threshold logic
criteria.description: Shows that all three checks pass and that one failed check would make the ledger fail.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for checking only two thresholds.

criteria.name: Concise answer format
criteria.description: Uses a compact JSON object or equivalent bullet list with units and one arithmetic sentence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct values in a verbose or poorly structured answer.
